Hero.naglowek: You do the talking — Catherly keeps track of contacts and results.
Hero.podtytul: Catherly is a system for running your own direct selling — contacts, content, team, and results in one place.

filar1.naglowek: In the morning, you see who to reach out to.
filar1.korzysc: You have a plan for the day and a contact base that grows while you do the talking.
filar1.konkret1: The DMO sets the order of your conversations — you start the day without hesitating.
filar1.konkret2: A reminder just before each meeting — you walk in prepared, not caught off guard.
filar1.konkret3: Every referral arrives with a trail — you know who sent her your way.

filar2.naglowek: You write. Shield checks. Ethical Seal confirms.
filar2.korzysc: The Studio learns your voice and makes sure no piece of content breaks your rules.
filar2.konkret1: The Studio comes with ready formats and templates — you never face a blank page.
filar2.konkret2: The Shield flags risky wording before you hit send.
filar2.konkret3: The Ethical Seal gives a score and a certificate — proof, not just a feeling.

filar3.naglowek: A new team member knows what to do from day one
filar3.korzysc: Instead of explaining it all to every new person, the onboarding wizard does it for you.
filar3.konkret1: The onboarding wizard walks her through each stage — no help from you needed.
filar3.konkret2: First 90 Days: four phases with missions — she sees the road ahead of her.
filar3.konkret3: Achievements and badges keep her engaged long after the start.

filar4.naglowek: You see growth even after a hard day
filar4.korzysc: The Dashboard shows where things stand today, and your results carry proof that lasts.
filar4.konkret1: Your Wrapped sums up the period — you see what you actually got done.
filar4.konkret2: A goal with milestones tells you how far you’ve come and what’s next.
filar4.konkret3: The Testimony with its digital fingerprint stays — others can verify your results.

Cennik.naglowek: Plans differ in scope, not in promises
Cennik.wstep: Every plan is the same system. The difference is scope — from your first contacts to your whole team structure.

starter.dlaKogo: For you if you’re just starting and want a clear plan for every day.
starter.pozycja1: Dashboard — one screen where you see your contacts and results
starter.pozycja2: DMO — a Daily Method of Operation that tells you what to do today
starter.pozycja3: Sign-up form with a public page — submissions go straight into your contact base
starter.pozycja4: Training Room — practice the hard answers before they come up for real
starter.pozycja5: Shield — catches risky wording before you send it

growth.dlaKogo: For you if you’re building a team and want to see how each of your people is doing.
growth.pozycja1: Team Pulse — you see the signs someone may be stepping back, with a ready line to open the conversation
growth.pozycja2: You see the full tree of your team structure

pro.dlaKogo: For you if you run a large structure and want to hand part of the work to others.
pro.pozycja1: Leaderboard — see where you stand among other users
pro.pozycja2: API keys and webhooks — connect Catherly to your own tools
pro.pozycja3: No limits on contacts, team, posts, and training sessions
pro.pozycja4: Clean export — your materials without a referral signature

faq.p1: Which currency will I pay in?
faq.o1: Prices on this page are in euros. Every plan also has a price in Polish złoty — you see the currency before you pay.
faq.p2: What if my plan stops being the right fit?
faq.o2: You choose a plan and change it whenever you like.
faq.p3: What if I decide it’s not for me?
faq.o3: You can cancel whenever you like. No reason needed.
faq.p4: What about my contacts when I cancel?
faq.o4: You export contacts to vCard and download your log as CSV — everything is yours.

Cennik.potwierdzenie2: Data export, always available: vCard and CSV

DbanieOSiebie.tresc: You collect proof of your work on the Wall of Proof. It’s a space where you celebrate, not just measure.

Problem.naglowek: Everything is somewhere. Each thing somewhere else.
Problem.tresc: You write posts once the house is asleep. In the morning you hunt for a number you know you saved somewhere. You hear what’s happening in your team later than you’d like.
Problem.kropka: In the evening you sit down with a notebook and add up what came of it.

Definicja.naglowek: Catherly is the memory of your selling
Definicja.tresc: Catherly remembers what you’ve been carrying in your head and your notebooks: what you promised to whom, which content went to which customer, and what sold. Your team is close at hand too — you see who you’re bringing in and how she’s doing. You still sell your way, just not from memory anymore.

RytmDnia.naglowek: What your day with Catherly looks like
RytmDnia.krok1Tresc: You open your Daily Action Plan and start conversations in a set order. The calendar reminds you of the rest.
RytmDnia.krok2Tresc: You check your contact base and know what you promised to whom. You build your post from a template in Studio.
RytmDnia.krok3Tresc: On the Dashboard, your day and your team’s day sit side by side.
RytmDnia.kropka: In the evening you see what came of it.

CennikSkrot.roznica: Every plan keeps track of your contacts and results — Growth adds a view of your whole team.

Obawy.p1: What if I can’t get the hang of another new app?
Obawy.o1: The onboarding wizard takes you step by step. First 90 Days gives you a ready plan for the start.
Obawy.p2: What about the contacts I already keep in other places?
Obawy.o2: There’s no bulk import — you add contacts by hand or through the form. You can always export them to vCard.
Obawy.p3: If I stop paying, does my data disappear?
Obawy.o3: You can cancel whenever you like. Export contacts to vCard, download your log as CSV — everything is yours.
Obawy.p4: I hold my customers' data. Who else sees it?
Obawy.o4: Only you have access to your account. The Shield keeps content ethical — the SHA-256 Testimony logs every change.
Obawy.p5: I hardly ever sit at a computer — will this work?
Obawy.o5: Built for the phone from day one — there’s no cut-down version. You open it and it works the way it should.
Obawy.p6: My company has its rules. Can I even use outside tools?
Obawy.o6: The Compliance Passport scans content against four jurisdictions' rules — but your company’s IT has the final say.

ZamkniecieGlowna.zdanie: You can cancel at any time.

ZamkniecieCennik.zdanie: Choose a plan and see how Catherly works in your day-to-day. Nothing ties you in — you can cancel whenever you like.
